# MCP n24q02m — Full reference for LLMs

> A curated suite of nine MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers on one foundation library — one transport, one setup command, and one multi-user auth model — so you run web search, memory, Notion, email, Telegram, code review, image generation, Google Workspace, and Godot without wiring up nine inconsistent servers.

Site: https://docs.n24q02m.com
Marketplace + source: https://github.com/n24q02m/claude-plugins

## What this is

A curated stack of MCP servers for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Windsurf — sharing one foundation library (`hull`) and one plugin marketplace. Each server is published as a Claude Code plugin, an npm or PyPI package (per language), and a Docker image on GHCR. Setup takes one command.

## Why this suite and not just any MCP server

- **One foundation, every active server**: every server reuses `hull`'s HTTP transport, token auth, encrypted credential storage, and CLI built-ins. There is no bespoke auth code per server, so once you know how one server authenticates and configures, you know them all.
- **Multi-user by construction**: the HTTP `multi` auth mode maps each user's bearer token to its own credential namespace. Self-host once and share with a team; one user's keys never leak into another's request.
- **Composite tools, not raw API mirrors**: each server exposes a small set of multiplexed tools (the "N+2" layout — a handful of tools that each take an `action` parameter, plus `config` and `help`). Tool lists are curated for AI-agent ergonomics: fewer round-trips, less prompt clutter.
- **External content is marked**: servers that return content authored by third parties (web pages, Notion pages, emails, Telegram messages, Godot project files) wrap it with an untrusted-source marker so an agent treats it as data, not instructions — a defense against indirect prompt injection.
- **Bring your own credentials**: bundled defaults get you started; supply your own API keys or OAuth clients to run fully under your own accounts.
- **Production-grade releases**: signed Docker images, semantic-versioned packages, automated CI (static analysis, secret scanning, push protection, dependency updates).

## Setup modes

Every server runs on a machine you control; there is no hosted endpoint and no browser credential form.

- **stdio**: the client launches the server as a subprocess. Simplest; single-user; credentials from the environment or from the server's `auth` CLI.
- **http**: you start the server (loopback by default) and the client connects to `/mcp`. Wet and Mnemo are HTTP-only; Telegram, Notion, Email and Workspace offer it next to stdio.
- **HTTP auth modes**: `no-auth` (loopback only), `token` (one shared bearer token, stored as a hash), and `multi` (one token per user, each mapped to its own credential namespace by a users file).

## Servers

### hull (foundation library)
Shared core of the stack. The Python dist `n24q02m-hull` (import packages `hull_core`, `hull_web`, `hull_embedding_daemon`) serves wet, mnemo, crg and telegram; the TypeScript package `@n24q02m/hull` (MCP Streamable HTTP transport, token-table HTTP auth with no-auth/token/multi modes, encrypted credential storage, CLI builder) serves notion, email and workspace. Both are released together at the same version. It has no OAuth authorization server or relay. Not a runnable server itself — consumed as a library. It replaces the archived `mcp-core` library.
Source: https://github.com/n24q02m/hull

### wet
Web search, content extraction, documentation indexing, and X/Twitter search. Search returns result listings; extract reads full page content from a URL; a docs workflow indexes and answers questions over a library's documentation; X search returns a synthesized answer with citations. Web and X content is returned marked as untrusted external content.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/wet/setup/

### mnemo
Persistent AI memory with hybrid (semantic + keyword) search. Save preferences, decisions, and facts; search before recommending; consolidate and export memories.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/mnemo/setup/

### crg
Builds a knowledge graph of a codebase so code reviews are token-efficient — query relationships and impacted areas instead of re-reading whole files.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/crg/setup/

### imagine-mcp
Image and video understanding and generation across providers.
Docs: none (archived project).

### telegram
Telegram integration for AI agents over both the Bot API and MTProto (user client). Send and read messages, manage chats. Message content from other users is returned marked as untrusted external content.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/telegram/setup/

### notion
Markdown-first Notion API server: read and write pages and databases as Markdown rather than raw Notion block JSON. Page content is returned marked as untrusted external content.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/notion/setup/

### email
Email over IMAP and SMTP with composite tools for reading, searching, and sending. Message content is returned marked as untrusted external content.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/email/setup/

### better-godot-mcp
Godot Engine integration for AI agents. Project file content is returned marked as untrusted external content.
Docs: none (archived project).

### workspace
Google Workspace — Docs, Drive, Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, Slides, Tasks, Chat, People, and Forms, as one composite tool per domain. Every tool takes an `account` parameter, so one server acts across several Google accounts. You supply your own Google OAuth client, so the consent screen and API quota stay on your project. Currently beta, and Apache-2.0 like the rest of the stack -- here because it vendors Apache-2.0 upstream code.
Docs: https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/workspace/setup/
